The robust current scientific scope is matched candidate identities; NN tricarbonyl versus NNS dicarbonyl oxidation ordering; the S-channel reduction ordering; within a fixed handed configuration the S/R energetic asymmetry; and the coupled half-reaction account. Original input decks, grids, frequency scaling and multiplicity are not printed; a closed-shell singlet Mn(I) model is an explicit assumption unless supported by new evidence.

scientific_rubric.description: Chemically valid active-form hypotheses lead to comparable catalytic states.
The matched alcohol-oxidation profiles contain real O-H/C-H transfer intermediates and barriers.
The stabilized isopropoxide reference changes the effective oxidation barrier.
Ketone-reduction profiles are computed for defined active forms and substrate faces.
S/R energetic asymmetry is conditional on the catalyst configuration.
The author NN tricarbonyl forms have lower alcohol-oxidation barriers than matched NNS dicarbonyl forms.
The S-channel reduction favors the author NNS dicarbonyl forms in the conditional comparison.
The paired author configurations have a lower S-faced than R-faced TS.
A coupled proton/hydride-transfer account connects both organic half-reactions.
Explain the influence of plausible coordination forms on both transfer-hydrogenation half-reactions.
State what a fixed-configuration calculation establishes about S/R formation.

reference_qualification.meaning: Source-qualified unresolved quantitative items remain in the rubric and cannot be certified completed or replaced by trend-only credit. This is not an additional AR investigation requirement.

comparison_policy.source_conflicts: Conflicting or undefined source values are not a unique numeric gold. Assess the explicitly scoped result; no numerical-closeness credit from choosing one conflicting report or widening tolerance.
comparison_policy.alternative_results: Scientifically supported alternatives may receive the relevant result/conclusion credit with clear physical equivalence and evidence. Documented limitations alone are not a solved result.
